text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected — spike in 5xx gateway errors from upstream provider 'edge-proxy' starting ~1769012300. Paging on-call rota. Severity: P2 :rotating_light:

Maya K: I'm on it. seeing 5xx rate jump to ~4.5% across eu-west-1 for the last 3m. latency ok, errors are mostly 502/504 gateway timeouts.

Carlos R: cutting an eye on upstream provider status page — they show a degraded network flap earlier but unclear if still impacting. Link: https://status.upstream.example/incidents/287

Ivy S: any customer-facing impact?

Maya K: yes, hosted API call failures for customers in EU — roughly 0.6% of total production requests are failing with 5xx, but for some customers who route all traffic to eu-west-1 it's up to 2.1%. realtime logs attached below.

Maya K: paste of relevant logs:
```
[2026-03-12T15:32:10Z] request_id=abc123 host=api.redwood.ai upstream=edge-proxy status=502 path=/v1/generate
[2026-03-12T15:33:01Z] request_id=def456 host=api.redwood.ai upstream=edge-proxy status=504 path=/v1/embeddings
```

Sam L: started mitigation: enabling retries with exponential backoff at edge layer for 502/504 (2 retries, jitter). Rolling to 10% of traffic now.

Maya K: also adding a temporary routing policy to shift 25% of eu-west-1 traffic to eu-central-1 for non-data-resident customers.

Aisha (oncall): I can take the handoff in 15. current status?

Carlos R: mitigation looks effective on rolling subset — 5xx drop from 4.5% -> 1.9% where retries + routing applied. But noise is high.

Ivy S: propose immediate alert tuning: current 5xx alert fires when 5xx > 0.5% for 1m window — that's too noisy for transient upstream blips. Suggest change to 5xx > 1.5% over 5m with min_requests > 500 in window. Also add a separate alert for gateway timeout spike (504) to avoid conflating backend bugs with upstream network issues.

Maya K: +1. We need to avoid paging for tiny transient blips. For on-call, paging threshold needs to indicate customer-impacting. Suggest paging only if 5xx% > 1.5% AND impacted_customers > 3 OR per-customer failure rate > 1%.

Sam L: creating quick dashboard tile for per-region 5xx%, request volume, and retry-success-rate. Will push as temp dashboard: eng:oncall/incident-1769012345.

incident-bot: NOTE — creating incident runbook entry: https://wiki.redwood/inbox/incidents/1769012345

Carlos R: small alert rule draft (prometheus-ish) to apply after incident stabilizes:
```
alert: HighGateway5xxRate
expr: (sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~"5..",region!="internal"}[5m]))
      / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])))*100 > 1.5
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  summary: "5xx rate > 1.5% over 5m"
  runbook: "https://wiki.redwood/inbox/incidents/alert-runbooks#5xx"
```

Ivy S: we should also add min_requests clause to avoid noisy percentages when traffic < 500 reqs: use `and sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) > 500`.

Maya K: agreed. also add a separate `GatewayTimeoutSpike` alert scoped to 504 and for the region only.

Aisha (oncall): handoff note — retry-routing mitigations active (25% shift + retries for eu-west-1). Error rate dropped to ~1.2% cluster-wide, region eu-west-1 at 1.8%. No ongoing customer escalations open in Zendesk yet. Will watch for 30m and then close incident if stable. Follow-up tasks for postmortem:
- formalize new alert thresholds and min_request gate.
- create per-customer failure-rate dashboard and a playbook entry for upstream provider failures.
- runbook: define when to shift traffic vs. when to rollback model deployments.

Sam L: filed ticket INF-7893 for dashboard + alert change. linking in runbook.

Maya K: FYI ops note — we found one route that had retries disabled via old flag; re-enabled globally. That cut retryable failures by ~0.4%.

Ivy S: for follow-up, recommend adding an additional metric: `upstream_5xx_by_provider` so we can route per-provider rather than region-based.

Aisha (oncall): taking over monitoring for the night. If 5xx% rises above 2% for 10m, page SRE lead. Otherwise we'll treat as ticketed follow-up. I'll post a short postmortem draft tomorrow.

Carlos R: thx all. closing page, leaving incident open for follow-up items. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT updated — status: mitigated, pager cleared. Reference: incident-1769012345
